name: Measurement and setpoint
description: Represents different aspects of a measured or a required value of some material property. In the measurement case an assay takes an object as input and outputs a measurement datum whose measurand is linked to the quality via specifies value of. In the setpoint case a specification datum carries a target value and the quality concretizes that specification datum instead of being measured.
competency_questions: What was measured, by which assay, and what value came out? Which quality is a measurement datum about? What is the required or target value of a property, as opposed to the observed one? Which specification datum does a quality concretize, and which plan specification does the process realize?
